finding: Pangram certification must use the reader-visible representation rather than raw source markup; raw Markdown can be diagnostic but cannot certify rendered publication text.
reason: The same Spiritual Bypassing content measured 100% Human as raw Markdown but 88.3194506% Human as the 1,482-word visible plaintext that reproduced the Pangram GUI, demonstrating a material representation/certification failure.
lesson_block:
### Reader-visible certification incident provenance
The Spiritual Bypassing representation incident established that a raw-Markdown Pangram pass cannot certify the reader-visible article. The same content scored 100% Human when raw Markdown was submitted but 88.3194506% Human after normalization to the 1,482-word visible plaintext that matched the GUI. Certification therefore uses the reader-visible representation; source-markup measurements are diagnostic only.
index_block: - **Reader-visible certification evidence:** the Spiritual Bypassing incident reproduced the GUI's 88.3% result through the API only after raw Markdown was normalized to reader-visible plaintext; raw-source detector passes are diagnostic only and cannot certify rendered publication text.
